caption:
Nobody tells you this: set up autopay for at least the minimum. ✅

A payment 30+ days late can be reported to the credit bureaus, and that can hurt your score for years.

Autopay the minimum as a safety net, then pay the rest yourself.

Do you use autopay?

card.headline: Autopay the minimum. Late payments can cost you for years.
card.sub: Then pay more when you can.
